Analytics Engine team members will be at AGU24 in Washington D.C. on December 9-13, 2024! If you are attending, we encourage you to visit the following posters and sessions:

- [Risk analysis for the energy sector via the Cal-Adapt Analytics Engine: A co-production approach for tailored climate analytics in a warming world](https://agu.confex.com/agu/agu24/meetingapp.cgi/Paper/1759187)
- [Co-producing guidance on the use of climate data for scientific and decision applications](https://agu.confex.com/agu/agu24/meetingapp.cgi/Paper/1518947)
